items.question_masked: What net monthly income must a personal loan applicant earn?
items.answer: Personal loan applicants must be aged 21–58, earn a net monthly income of at least ₹25,000 and hold a credit score of 700 or more. Personal loan interest ranges from 10.5% to 24% p.a. by credit score band: 10.5–12% for scores of 800 and above, 12–16% for 750–799 and 16–24% for 700–749.

items.question_masked: When does the first EMI fall due after disbursal?

items.question_masked: What prepayment penalty applies to a fixed-rate personal loan in the first 12 EMIs?
items.answer: Fixed-rate personal loans charge a prepayment penalty of 4% of the prepaid principal during the first 12 EMIs and 2% after that. Loan EMIs use the reducing-balance formula EMI = P·r·(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where P is the principal, n is the number of monthly instalments and r = annual rate/12/100.
